```yaml
name: Dependabot Auto-Merge

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Only CI/CT"]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  validate-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Fetch metadata for Dependabot PR
        id: fetch_metadata
        uses: dependabot/fetch-metadata@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          alert-lookup: true
          compat-lookup: true

      - name: Check if PR is from Dependabot
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}" != "dependabot[bot]" ]]; then
            echo "::set-output name=is_dependabot=false"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=is_dependabot=true"
          fi

      - name: Get PR number
        run: echo "::set-output name=pr_number${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"

      - name: Check PR status
        id: check_status
        run: |
          has_validation=false
          for check_name in $(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.sha }}/check-runs?per_page=100 | jq -r '.check_runs[].name'); do
            if [[ "$check_name" == *"Integration Tests"* ]]; then
              has_validation=true
              break
            fi
          done
          echo "::set-output name=has_validation=$has_validation"

      - name: Wait for 5 seconds
        run: sleep 5

      - name: Check if any checks have failed or been cancelled
        id: check_failures
        run: |
          failures=false
          for check_name in $(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.sha }}/check-runs?per_page=100 | jq -r '.check_runs[].name'); do
            if [[ "$check_name" == *"Integration Tests"* ]]; then
              status=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.sha }}/check-runs/$check_name | jq -r '.status')
              conclusion=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.sha }}/check-runs/$check_name | jq -r '.conclusion')
              if [[ "$status" == "failure" || "$status" == "cancelled" || "$conclusion" == "failure" ]]; then
                failures=true
                break
              fi
            fi
          done
          echo "::set-output name=failures=$failures"

      - name: Merge PR if all checks pass
        if: ${{ steps.check_failures.outputs.failures == 'false' && steps.has_validation.outputs.has_validation == 'true' }}
        run: |
          gh pr merge --auto --squash --merge-commit-message="Auto-merge PR #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} due to successful integration tests."

  approve-pr:
    needs: validate-pr
    if: ${{ needs.validate-pr.outcome == 'success' && needs.validate-pr.steps.check_failures.outputs.failures == 'false' && needs.validate-pr.steps.has_validation.outputs.has_validation == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Approve PR
        uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          pull-request-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          merge-method: squash
```
